reference.role: Full original style reference only; never runtime art

body.prompt: Use the supplied full-screen reference only as artistic guidance. Generate one independent isolated UI resource: the SINGLE golden currency coin in the top HUD near the name. One upright round gold coin, almost front-facing with very slight perspective, embossed eight-point sun/star compass emblem and tiny circular center, double rim and fine engraved ornamental edge. Match the reference exact warm subdued antique gold, controlled creamy highlights, deep amber recessed engraving, dark side edge. Crisp detailed painterly Slavic fairy-tale game art. No pile, no overlapping second coin, no text, no digits, no plus button, no other icons, no scenery. Entire coin centered occupying 88 percent of image, true transparent outside alpha and fully opaque metal interior. Not a screenshot crop.
